testResults.name: backtest-runner-and-manifest
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/harness/runtime -q
testResults.result: 36 tests passed across runner, manifest, and fixture modules: a one-month synthetic SPY run is artifact-identical across repeated execution, every reproducibility input (configuration, code, seed, data, fill model, fees, risk, strategies) affects the manifest hash under a 10-case parametrization, and abort, per-strategy halt, teardown, and look-ahead policies are tested.

testResults.name: cli-local-benchmark
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/harness/cli -q
testResults.result: 14 CLI tests passed including end-to-end backtest-job runs that produce byte-identical canonical artifacts across repeated executions, plus missing-configuration and wrong-shell rejection paths.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed; the runner uses one SimClock-driven EventBus, exact Decimal arithmetic, and no wall-clock, unseeded random, network, or credential access.

decisions: The runner accepts None (deterministic synthetic fixture), a ReplayFixture, a stream mapping, or a local Parquet lake directory path, keeping the local benchmark fully offline.

The backtest runner is a submodule package (errors/fills/fees/fixture/preflight/manifest/strategies/engine) behind the unchanged harness.runtime.backtest import surface, and the CLI writes canonical artifacts under .local/backtests/<run_id>.
limitations: The committed example configuration still targets the T097 reference momentum strategy, so running it fails with a clean StrategyLoadError until T097 lands; the built-in synthetic fixture and ReferenceStrategy path are fully runnable now.
